scope: Proposition 4.2 (Transmission) of the manuscript “Buffered comparison and stopping-band resolution in critical Ising” (preprints/Buffered-comparison-and-stopping-band-resolution-in-critical-Ising-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 218 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d5167e3fe5fb85f4), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 11-12. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is an exponent δ ∈ (0, 1/8), chosen by decreasing the exponent of Corollary 2.5 if necessary, with the following property. Prescribe two ordered con- figurations on S, use identical common pins elsewhere, and let ∆ denote higher-law expectation minus lower-law expectation. For an admissible separating cut at scales w, s, a bounded observable h supported on T, and w sufficiently large, |∆h| ≤ C∥h∥∞(w/s)−7/8+δ ∆MJ . (4.2) 11 Equivalently, if ∥h∥∞ ≤ H for fixed H > 0, ∆MJ ≥ cH(w/s)7/8−δ |∆h|. (4.3) The constants are uniform as w/s decreases within the stated geometry.
